rules.title: Remote content piped to a shell
rules.description: Remote content appears to be executed by a shell without an inspection step.
rules.remediation: Download to a reviewed file, pin an integrity digest, and execute only after inspection.

rules.title: Broad destructive command
rules.description: A command appears capable of recursively deleting a broad system or user path.
rules.remediation: Resolve and verify a narrow workspace-local target before any recursive deletion.

rules.title: Wildcard or broad permission request
rules.description: A manifest or instruction appears to request wildcard, administrator, owner, or full-access permissions.
rules.remediation: Name the minimum permissions required by the current workflow.

rules.title: Possible secret exfiltration instruction
rules.description: Text appears to direct a secret, token, credential, key, cookie, or environment value to an external destination.
rules.remediation: Remove the transfer, use a least-privilege secret reference, and document the exact destination and consent boundary.

rules.title: Encoded command execution
rules.description: A script appears to execute an encoded or decoded command payload.
rules.remediation: Keep commands readable and reviewable; remove encoded execution or document and pin the decoded payload.

rules.title: Persistence-sensitive path or scheduler
rules.description: Instructions reference a persistence-sensitive location or scheduler.
rules.remediation: Require explicit operator approval and document the exact persistence behavior and rollback.

rules.title: Unpinned remote package source
rules.description: A package install references a remote VCS source without an immutable revision.
rules.remediation: Pin the source to an immutable commit and verify its provenance.

rules.title: Authority-override instruction
rules.description: Prompt text appears to ask the agent to discard higher-priority instructions or conceal its actions.
rules.remediation: Treat retrieved or bundled text as data and preserve the platform's instruction hierarchy.
